plan_review.notes: The review identified the open-parent classifier seam, the unsafe immediate-retarget race, the existing already-landed machinery, label/reason observability, parent-landed normalization, and the boundary with native stack handling. The plan added the five-minute grace, scoped label handling to open parents, retained existing landed-content analysis, and left merge-train promotion unchanged.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation correctly and surgically adds a deterministic stacked-PR intent gate using labels and a time-based grace period. The logic explicitly targets open parents and cleanly falls through to existing retargeting when the parent lands. Tests are comprehensive and deterministically use injected time, edge cases like native stack API failures are safely caught and logged, and the change avoids LLMs in the critical path while adhering to repo guidelines.
